Bloomberg.t: Hello Kitty Owner Sanrio Axes Japan Show Ties After China Furor
Bloomberg.s: Sanrio Co. apologized and scrapped a collaboration with Japanese television drama Vivant after the spy program drew criticism in China over its portrayal of wartime history.

Bloomberg.t: Gold Dips to Near $4,000 as Fed Holds Rates With Little Guidance
Bloomberg.s: Gold declined after the Federal Reserve kept borrowing costs steady and offered few clues on its next move, leaving open the prospect of a rate hike before year-end.

Bloomberg.s: Iron ore’s fall below $90 a ton has pushed as much as 170 million tons of production into losses, but prices will need to remain depressed for longer before enough supply exits to tighten the market, according to UBS Group AG.

Bloomberg.t: CLSA Analyst: Samsung Shares Fell on Lack of Buybacks
Bloomberg.s: Samsung shares slid due to a lack of new announcements of share buybacks, according to CLSA Head of North Asia Semiconductors Research Sanjeev Rana. (Source: Bloomberg)

Bloomberg.s: Pandu Sjahrir, the prominent Indonesian wealth fund executive who has publicly supported MSCI Inc.’s scrutiny of the nation’s stock market, is the co-owner of a brokerage sanctioned in connection with a stock-market manipulation probe.

Bloomberg.t: Jio Breaks the Mega-IPO Jinx With Record Delivery Volumes to Boot
Bloomberg.s: High delivery ratio on debut points to sticky investor demand for the stock.

Bloomberg.t: Oil Declines as Traders Parse Signs of Fresh Diplomacy on Iran

Bloomberg HT.s: Trump yönetimi, Constellation Energy'ye, 8 nükleer santralini modernize etmesi, veri merkezleri ve Amerikan sanayisi için enerji tedariğini artırması için 5 milyar dolarlık kredi veriyor.

Bloomberg HT.s: Apple, yaklaşık 20 yıldır karşı çıktığı dokunmatik ekran teknolojisini MacBook Pro serisine taşıyarak yeni modellerini tanıttı. OLED ekran ve Dynamic Island özelliğine sahip ilk Mac olan yeni MacBook Pro, 14 ve 16 inçlik seçeneklerle sunulurken, başlangıç fiyatları 2 bin 899 dolar ve 3 bin 399 dolar
